item.title: seeCph: Testing and Refactoring DAOs
item.author: theisrud@gmail.com (Theis Rud Halkjær)
item.description: This week was all about getting test-ready for basic CRUD operations across all DAOs. For that, I also needed to add exceptions to my DAO methods. I decided to do a big refactoring and create a generic jig with all basic CRUD operations for easier maintenance in the future.
